auth_description: Free Alpha Vantage API key. Free tier is 25 requests/day; the CLI tracks quota in a local quota_log.

novel_features.name: Quota status + dry-run plan
novel_features.description: See exactly how many of your 25/day Alpha Vantage calls you have left, and preview what a command would burn before running it.

novel_features.name: News sweep with ticker_sentiment preserved
novel_features.description: Pull NEWS_SENTIMENT for a watchlist in one command; persist articles AND the per-ticker sentiment array every other wrapper drops.

novel_features.name: Sentiment timeline for a ticker
novel_features.description: Day-by-day mean sentiment + article count for a ticker, computed from local data with zero API calls.

novel_features.name: FTS5 news search
novel_features.description: Full-text search across all locally pulled news articles with boolean AND/OR, prefix matching, ranked results.

novel_features.name: Pre-earnings briefing
novel_features.description: One-shot pre-earnings card: upcoming earnings date, recent earnings-topic news, last call transcript highlights, current quote.

novel_features.name: Movers + sentiment overlay
novel_features.description: Today's top gainers/losers with each ticker's 7d sentiment z-score from the local store.

novel_features.name: Macro snapshot
novel_features.description: Current CPI, Fed Funds Rate, Treasury Yield curve, Unemployment, Nonfarm Payroll in one card.

novel_features.name: Watchlist sentiment with delta
novel_features.description: Per-ticker mean sentiment for a named watchlist, with delta-since-last-scan.

novel_features.name: Compound screen
novel_features.description: Filter tickers by multi-predicate (min sentiment, earnings within N days, recent insider net-buy) across local tables.

novel_features.name: Daily pulse bundle
novel_features.description: Designed for /market-pulse: top movers + macro snapshot + watchlist sentiment delta in <=2 API calls.

novel_features.name: Sync backbone
novel_features.description: Pull-once-query-many: hydrate the local store with news, movers, or earnings calendar; incremental cursor avoids re-fetching.
